deliveryRules: Use the real original reference pixels, exact Store item metadata and existing design contracts together; never copy incorrect screenshot answers, fake balances or unsafe sale messaging into game logic.
Complete 2-4 item pilot batches through actual save/readback/render/review before scaling a visual recipe; a failed recipe must change instead of generating 12 more flat icons.

New art uses available image-generation tools or appropriate existing approved assets. No generic emoji, placeholder geometry, recolor-only clones, third-party IP or Roblox/Brookhaven assets. No purchases or new paid-service settings.
Each candidate records exact ID/name/category/tier/theme, versioned path, producer, measured bytes/dimensions and hash. Local-only or Git-object-only files are not branch-staged.

One independent actual-pixel ACCEPT for the exact current hash plus valid mapping/file checks lets 08 integrate immediately. Do not wait for all 192 or both historical rollups; genuine disagreement blocks that version.

Review material depth, silhouette, camera, light, framing, category realism, exact theme, tier progression and mobile card readability. SVG format is neither automatic failure nor approval; inspect actual pixels.
No force-push, stale whole-file overwrite, reference-image alteration, discarded concurrent output, self-approval, status-only churn or fabricated tests/percentages.
Run existing affected regressions and builds as integration safeguards. Nonvisual release checks are deferred work, never waived or marked PASS without execution.
Keep the child app interactive and real-state-bound; do not place the screenshot over the game or hide essential UI to improve a diff score.
